title: IP Content Projection API Contract

rules: returns content related to the IP through authoritative content relationships
does not create or mutate ownership rights
visibility and moderation policy are applied before projection
content relationship must exist and be active
private or moderated content is not leaked

invariants: Content Relationship is the relationship authority
principal is the canonical IP principal concept
ip_founder and founder are forbidden role values
projection must never grant access beyond content visibility and entitlement
